// Fixed generic steps used by the two CreateDynamicFunction realm subjects.
// Source compilation and the dynamically constructed result stay excluded.
const realmA = $262.createRealm();
const realmB = $262.createRealm();
realmA.global.calls = 0;
const ordinary = realmA.evalScript('(function () { calls += 1; })');
const newTarget = realmB.evalScript('(function () {})');
newTarget.prototype = null;
// The ordinary GetFunctionRealm branch, not a bound or Proxy substitute.
const fallback = Reflect.construct(Object, [], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(fallback), realmB.global.Object.prototype);
// MakeConstructor creates the ordinary function's prototype in its own realm.
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(ordinary), realmA.global.Function.prototype);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(ordinary.prototype), realmA.global.Object.prototype);
assert(new ordinary() instanceof realmA.global.Object);
assert.sameValue(realmA.global.calls, 1);
console.log('DS19 function-creation complete');
